scope.supported: All16 Native procedures, all branches/options/diagnostics including source multiple-LHS and Godunov options; retain all same supported controls as JAX without its unfinished multiple-LHS main rejection. Sponge lower call can stay explicit/bridged or upstream rejected with existing JAX scope, decided with root.
scope.matrix_layout: Native matrix local/argument bands-first order retained; actual C++ matrix_solver_wrapper boundary transposes to(column,band,row) and restores Native InOut lhs. RHS/solutions(column,row,RHS).
scope.indices: Preserve Native1-based loop metadata/logical scalar IDs; shift only array-address expressions. Generated tunable indices already zero-based.
scope.recurrence: update_xp2_mc precipitation fraction retains serial descending physical-level recurrence independently in each column. Shared solve mode predicates reduce integers, not floating values.
scope.state: Call-local column-first Kokkos Views; individual UDT component aliases in kernels; no global scratch. Native matrix bands-first layout exception explicit at solver boundary.
scope.stats: Native stats backend allfield-specific updates/budgets retained. Missing stats_update_budget and explicit l_count_sample=false finalize overload must be provided by existing bridge owner at promotion.
scope.errors: Native fatal all-column checks and detailed dumps, return locations and option guard semantics; no silent fallback.
scope.bfb: No speculative arithmetic adaptation; CPU Fortran vs CPU Kokkos zero tolerance is root integration gate, GPU occasional milestones.
